verdict.rationale: Helicone documents a dedicated Alerts feature for monitoring error rates and cost spikes (helicone-docs-11), and webhooks for real-time notifications tied to request events (helicone-docs-9, helicone-docs-23), but the evidence pack never mentions eval-score-drop alerts or specific delivery channels like Slack, PagerDuty, or email. Missing for 10: eval-score-based alert triggers, and documented integrations/notification channels (Slack, PagerDuty, email).
